title: Testing the Exclusion Restriction with a Single Instrument: Identification through Fourth-Order Cumulants under Latent Confounding
abstract: arXiv:2603.13505v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: With a single instrument the exclusion restriction is untestable from second moments, and adding the instrument to the structural equation fails because the regressor is endogenous. When the endogeneity comes from a latent common cause with non-Gaussian components, the restriction becomes generically testable from the fourth-order cumulants of the first-stage and 2SLS residuals: a closed-form scalar $\theta$ is zero under exclusion and non-zero otherwise, while the direct effect itself is identified only up to two points. A companion statistic measures identification strength. Simulations show correct size under confounding, where the naive OLS test always rejects. In Card's (1995) data the test is uninformative, and says so.

translated_title: 使用单个工具变量检验排他性约束：在潜在混杂下通过四阶累积量进行识别
translated_abstract: 当只有一个工具变量时，排他性约束无法从二阶矩中检验，而将工具变量加入结构方程也会因为回归变量具有内生性而失效。当内生性来源于一个具有非高斯分量的潜在共同原因时，该约束通常可以通过第一阶段残差和2SLS（两阶段最小二乘）残差的四阶累积量来检验：一个闭式标量 $\theta$ 在排他性约束成立时为零，否则非零，而直接效应本身最多只能识别到两个点。论文还提出了一个配套统计量来衡量识别强度。模拟结果表明，在存在混杂的情况下该检验具有正确的检验水平，而朴素的OLS检验总是会拒绝原假设。在Card（1995）的数据中，该检验无法提供有效信息，并且检验结果本身明确地表明了这一点。
tldr: 本文提出，当内生性来自具有非高斯分量的潜在共同原因时，可利用第一阶段与2SLS残差的四阶累积量构造闭式统计量，从而在使用单个工具变量的情况下检验排他性约束，并配套统计量衡量识别强度。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that when endogeneity stems from a latent common cause with non-Gaussian components, the exclusion restriction with a single instrument becomes testable via a closed-form statistic based on fourth-order cumulants of first-stage and 2SLS residuals, complemented by a companion statistic for identification strength.
